text: Lesson eight pulled every document out of Wrenfield's three Blob Storage folders and chunked them. None of it is searchable yet.
This lesson embeds every single chunk with Azure OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small, then pushes the vectors into a brand-new index: wrenfield-knowledge-index.
The index is built for hybrid search -- vector similarity and keyword search running side by side on the same documents.
Every chunk ingestion produced gets embedded and indexed, from all three folders, with no filtering applied anywhere in this step.
Next: turning a real employee question into a query, and pulling back the five best-matching chunks.
